description: This file defines an enumeration for account association types within the account domain of the Fineract project. It specifies different association states such as invalid, linked account, and guarantor account, along with utility methods for converting from integer values and checking association types.

classes.name: AccountAssociationType
classes.description: Enumeration representing various account association types, including invalid, linked account, and guarantor account.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding AccountAssociationType enum value.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if the current enumeration has the specified state.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the enum.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the enum.

methods.name: isLinkedAccountAssociation
methods.description: Determines if the current instance represents a linked account association.

methods.name: isGuarantorAccountAssociation
methods.description: Determines if the current instance represents a guarantor account association.
